scope: Reference layout, not a fabrication-ready assembly

parts.name: ESP32-S3 controller
parts.price_basis: Manufacturer reference price; obtain a supplier quote
parts.dimension_basis: Official PCB outline; 12 mm populated height is a clearance allowance
parts.notes: DevKitC pinout, not the Feather board; two current firmware copies drive only two servos

parts.name: Positional micro servo
parts.availability: Out of stock at checked supplier
parts.dimension_basis: Supplier nominal body dimensions; tabs, spline and wire exit need measurement
parts.notes: Reference actuator only; torque/travel and current must be measured before committing to four arms

parts.name: Joystick module
parts.notes: External operator controls; run analog outputs at 3.3 V

parts.name: Force-sensitive resistor
parts.dimension_basis: Supplier overall envelope; sensing pad is not the entire rectangle
parts.notes: Reference pads shown separately until contact-pad mounts are designed; not calibrated load cells

parts.name: Servo supply
parts.dimension_basis: Unverified planning envelope; actual power brick must be measured
parts.notes: External tabletop supply only; simultaneous stall-current budget remains unverified

parts.name: DC input adapter
parts.model: 2.1 mm jack to terminal block; Adafruit 368
parts.notes: Positive-tip low-voltage input; strain relief and current rating need verification

parts.name: FSR divider resistors
parts.price_basis: Planning allowance; exact pack not selected
parts.notes: Use two resistors for core and four for full layout; pack must contain at least four

parts.name: Printed shell and segments
parts.model: Author's octopus geometry; PETG/TPU choice pending
parts.price_basis: Material allocation estimate, not a printing-service quote
parts.availability: Material and print settings not selected
parts.dimension_basis: Original STL in millimetres; no design dimensions invented
parts.notes: One shell plus 24 segment pieces; existing printer and tools assumed; original editable CAD still needed

parts.name: Tendon and return materials
parts.model: Line and elastic return trial allowance
parts.price_basis: Planning allowance; exact line and return system not selected
parts.dimension_basis: Not modeled: routing, anchoring and return mechanism unresolved
parts.notes: No assumption that releasing a servo automatically straightens an arm

parts.name: Mounts and fasteners
parts.price_basis: Planning allowance; quantities and sizes not finalized
parts.dimension_basis: Not modeled: shell mounts and joint axes need measurement
parts.notes: Do not drill from envelope CAD; retain servo's included horn/screw hardware

parts.name: Wiring and prototyping materials
parts.model: Wire, connectors, board and protection allowance
parts.price_basis: Planning allowance; exact parts and protection rating not selected
parts.dimension_basis: Not modeled: harness and power-distribution layout unresolved
parts.notes: Includes common ground, separate servo rail, supply disconnect and suitable overcurrent protection

parts.name: Controller USB cables
parts.price_basis: Planning allowance; exact cable not selected
parts.dimension_basis: Not modeled: connector and cable bend clearances unresolved
parts.notes: Power controllers from USB during initial bench tests; do not parallel USB and external 5 V without checking board instructions

parts.name: Raspberry Pi
parts.price_basis: Manufacturer reference price; supplier quote needed
parts.dimension_basis: Nominal PCB outline; 12 mm height is a populated clearance allowance
parts.notes: Optional external brain reference; roof mount/protection and Pi software remain to be designed

parts.name: Display
parts.dimension_basis: 85 x 50 mm is an unverified layout allowance; supplier lists 7.9 mm thickness
parts.notes: Optional SPI display; no touchscreen controller, cutout, mount or display software supplied

parts.name: Pi storage
parts.price_basis: Planning allowance; exact stocked card not selected
parts.dimension_basis: Generic microSD outline; shown separately from socket
parts.notes: Use an appropriate current Raspberry Pi OS image; card socket engagement not modeled

parts.name: Pi power
parts.notes: External supply; requires correct micro-USB power adapter, not the servo rail

parts.name: Pi power adapter cable
parts.model: 2.1 mm barrel to micro-USB power cable allowance
parts.price_basis: Planning allowance; exact cable not selected
parts.notes: Verify polarity and supply connector fit before powering Pi

parts.name: Shipping and tax
parts.notes: Multiple suppliers or printing services can cost more

parts.name: Prototype contingency
parts.notes: Does not cover a major actuator redesign
